title: 公共交通退出经历研究

documents.name: 教学案例 · 六段虚构访谈摘录
On the Origin of Species — eye passage

paragraphs.text: 上个月有三次公交晚到二十分钟。我得接孩子，后来就改开车了。
车票不贵，主要是每天要换两次车，第二趟经常接不上。
高峰期挤得转不了身。我有时候宁愿多花点钱打车。
一个月交通费大概一百二十，但这个钱对我没什么压力。
晚上那趟车让我不太放心。
以前经常晚点，不过改了时刻表以后好多了。现在不坐，主要是公司搬家了。

To suppose that the eye, with all its inimitable contrivances for adjusting the focus to different distances, for admitting different amounts of light, and for the correction of spherical and chromatic aberration, could have been formed by natural selection, seems, I freely confess, absurd in the highest possible degree. Yet reason tells me, that if numerous gradations from a perfect and complex eye to one very imperfect and simple, each grade being useful to its possessor, can be shown to exist; if further, the eye does vary ever so slightly, and the variations be inherited, which is certainly the case; and if any variation or modification in the organ be ever useful to an animal under changing conditions of life, then the difficulty of believing that a perfect and complex eye could be formed by natural selection, though insuperable by our imagination, can hardly be considered real.

labels.name: 可靠性问题
labels.definition: 晚点、取消或到达时间不确定，使出行难以安排。
labels.include: 明确描述服务时间不可靠。
labels.exclude: 车程长但时间稳定；不能由接不上车自行推断晚点。

labels.name: 换乘负担
labels.definition: 换乘次数、步行或接续等待造成出行负担。
labels.include: 明确描述换乘带来的困难。

labels.name: 费用负担
labels.definition: 交通支出造成压力或因价格而放弃公共交通。
labels.include: 明确表达负担不起、票价过高或费用压力。
labels.exclude: 价格不贵、没有压力；为改善体验接受额外支出。

labels.name: 舒适度问题
labels.definition: 拥挤、座位、温度或噪声造成乘车不适。
labels.include: 明确描述身体或感官不适。
labels.exclude: 笼统的不放心、不想坐，含义未明时保留歧义。
